content.title: Kroger Easter hours 2026: Is Kroger open on Easter Sunday
content.text: Plenty of retailers and restaurants close on Easter Sunday. But if on Easter morning, which this year is Sunday, April 5, you discover you’re missing a few essential items for your holiday festivities, you might wonder: Is Kroger open on Easter? Whether you need chocolate eggs, a honey-baked ham, or sparkling wine for mimosas, Kroger could be your go-to. Kroger is known for its budget-friend holiday meal deals. These are especially welcome during these times of inflation and increasing food costs, so if you have a Kroger in your neighborhood, it might be the place you head to first. Unlike many grocers that close for the holiday, Kroger typically keeps its doors open. So here's the short answer: Yes, most Kroger stores are open on Easter Sunday. However, hours may be reduced depending on location. Some locations may close earlier than usual, and pharmacy hours are often more limited than hours for the main grocery store. Most Kroger locations will be open from 6 a.m. until 10 p.m. but because Kroger operates thousands of stores nationwide, customers are encouraged to check their local store using the Kroger app or website before heading out. The following brands operate under the Kroger umbrella and these stores’ hours may also be limited on Easter. Baker’s, City Market Dillons Food 4 Less Foods Co Fred Meyer Fry’s Gerbes Jay C Food Store King Soopers Mariano’s Metro Market Pay-Less Super Markets Pick’n Save QFC Ralphs Ruler Smith’s Food and Drug One thing that makes Kroger especially popular during holidays like Easter is its focus on convenience and meal packages that simplify meal planning. The company has built a reputation for offering ready-to-make holiday meal bundles and affordable packages that take the stress out of hosting. In recent years, Kroger has promoted complete Easter meal deals featuring ham, sides, and dessert for as little as about $6 per person, giving families a budget-friendly way to prepare a full holiday spread. Customers can also order prepared meals, ready-to-heat options, and full ingredient bundles online for pickup or delivery. Kroger operates thousands of stores in the U.S.; customers appreciate the stores for its meal deals. Houston Chronicle/Hearst Newspapers on Getty Images · Houston Chronicle/Hearst Newspapers on Getty Images Just as the company does for every holiday, Kroger has plenty of deals for Easter. For Easter 2026, Kroger offers: Ham for as little as 85 cents a pound. Fresh spring vegetables, including asparagus, for $1.99 per pound. King's Hawaiian Rolls for $3.99. While Kroger stays open on Easter, there are also plenty of grocers that close. That list includes: Aldi BJs Costco Lidl Publix Sam’s Club Target Founded in 1883 in Cincinnati, Ohio, by Bernard Kroger, The Kroger Co. has become the largest supermarket chain in the United States and, according to Statista, is now one of the largest overall retailers, behind retail giant Walmart. Kroger reported quarterly revenue of roughly $45 billion Adjusted earnings per share came in at about $1.49 per share. Identical sales (excluding fuel) rose about 3.2%. E-commerce sales increased roughly 15% year over year. Kroger expects identical sales growth of 1% to 2% for 2026. Dana Sullivan Kilroy April 5, 2026 2 min read Trader Joe's doesn't sell Easter brunch meal deals the way some other grocers, such as Kroger and Safeway, do, but shoppers can find everything from eggs and honey-baked hams to pastries and all the ingredients you need to make a mimosa. So if you haven't quite finished all your grocery shopping for your Easter brunch or dinner yet, you might be wondering if your local Trader Joe's location is open, given that many major grocers either close entirely or operate on limited hours on the holiday. That’s why many shoppers find themselves asking the same question each spring: Is Trader Joe’s open on Easter? Most Trader Joe’s locations will be open on Easter Sunday, giving customers a chance to pick up last-minute groceries, chocolate Easter eggs, flowers or other seasonal favorites. So the answer is yes — but with a small caveat. "For your Easter festivities, we have Uncured Spiral Sliced Hams, Four Cheese Scalloped Potatoes, Haricot Verts, and lots and lots of Candy!" the company's website says. "And this year, you'll have more time on Easter to pick up your favorites. All Trader Joe's locations will be open regular hours on Sunday, April 5, with one exception: Trader Joe's Portland, Maine, which will be closed." Almost all Trader Joe's stores will be open on Easter Sunday.Elliott Cowand Jr./Shutterstock · Elliott Cowand Jr./Shutterstock Unlike some major retailers that close completely for Easter, Trader Joe’s remains open on its usual schedule — a move that reflects its broader approach to holiday scheduling. The company only closes stores three days each year: New Year’s Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day. On some holidays, Trader Joe's may close early the night before, including Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve. Since food prices are up 4.8% over the year, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, plenty of folks are looking for a place where they can get the most value for every dollar, and at Trader Joe's, prices for staples like milk and eggs are competitive with warehouse stores like Costco, without the need for a membership. Americans will be spending a record amount for the 2026 Easter holiday, about $24.9 billion, per the National Retail Federation. That includes $3.9 billion on gifts, $3.5 billion on candy, and $2.2 billion on flowers. On a per-person basis, shoppers are budgeting a record high of $195.59, up from $192.01 in 2023. Add TheStreet as a Preferred Source by clicking here. Madison Troyer April 5, 2026 2 min read For many Americans, Walmart has become the go-to destination for seasonal items. The retailer’s massive footprint (it currently has upwards of 5,000 locations in the U.S.) and commitment to everyday low prices (Walmart items are 10-25% less than competitors, on average) make it one of the most accessible and affordable places to get those holiday goods. After all, in the midst of the hustle and bustle that typically surrounds a holiday like Easter, nothing is better than being able to pick up your honey-baked ham and basket stuffers all in the same place. Even better, Walmart is open on Easter Sunday. Whether you need to pop in to grab that potluck side dish you forgot, or grab a few dozen plastic eggs for the Easter bunny to find, the retailer has your back. Most Walmart stores will be open normal hours on Easter 2026. The retailer plans to operate with regular hours, from 6 a.m to 11 p.m. However, some individual stores may close earlier than usual to accommodate employee scheduling. Walmart pharmacies will also be operating on reduced Sunday hours, open from just 10 a.m to 6 p.m. You can check the Easter Sunday hours of your preferred Walmart locations here. Walmart is open on Easter Sunday for shoppers' last-minute needs.Shutterstock · Shutterstock If Easter snuck up on you this year, Walmart has the perfect solution for your holiday meal. The retailer is currently offering a limited-time meal deal for eight, priced at just $34.91. The package includes an entree, several sides, and ingredients for a seasonal dessert — everything you could need for a proper holiday feast. Items include: Marketside boneless spiral-cut brown sugar double glazed ham Fresh whole asparagus Fresh baby carrots Green Giant extra sweet corn on the cob Fresh whole russet potatoes Great Value Deluxe mac & cheese Great Value large white eggs Great Value brown & serve dinner rolls Betty Crocker cream cheese frosting Betty Crocker super moist carrot cake mix Source: Walmart For shoppers looking to get ahead on next year’s holiday prep, Walmart will be marking down Easter items by 50-90% starting on April 6, 2026. Dana Sullivan Kilroy April 5, 2026 3 min read Easter Sunday is here, and whether your holiday includes an Easter Egg hunt or brunch, or you just need to get some errands done, you might have a Target run on your to-do list. But given that Easter is a major holiday in the U.S. — the stock market is even closed on the Friday before — many restaurants and retailers give employees the day off. Major retailers such as Costco, Lowe's, and Aldi count Easter Sunday as one of the few days they're closed each year. But how about Target, the store that is a one-stop shop for many American consumers? According to Target, all stores will be closed on April 5, 2026, so team members can spend the holiday with family, according to the company website. Like most major retailers, Target adjusts its schedule around key holidays. Closing on Easter Sunday is common these days. Other major retailers, including Costco, Sam's Club, and Aldi, also give their employees the day off. In recent years, Target has suffered consumer boycotts related to changes to its diversity, equity, and inclusion policies.Bloomberg/Getty Images · Bloomberg/Getty Images Easter is a critical time for retailers like Target, as demand for food, candy, and holiday decor typically boosts sales during an otherwise slow time of year. Target has reported multiple consecutive quarters of declining revenue, including a recent period where sales fell about 1.5% to $30.45 billion, reflecting weaker discretionary spending and lower store traffic, according to Reuters. Executives also acknowledged that a consumer boycott tied to its rollback of diversity initiatives weighed on performance, adding pressure during key shopping periods. Related: Rising gas prices force Americans to make unexpected changes In response, Target is pushing a turnaround strategy that includes $5 billion in investments, expanded promotions, and price cuts on thousands of items. All of these moves are aimed at attracting budget-conscious shoppers during holidays like Easter, when value and convenience are especially important. "While economic uncertainty remains on the minds of many, consumers are still focused on holiday celebrations like Easter,” Chief Economist and Executive Director of Research at the National Retail Federation Mark Mathews said. “Holidays provide an important opportunity for families to reconnect and create lasting memories, even as economic conditions fluctuate.” As for Target, seasonal demand could help lift short-term results, but the company is still working to reverse five straight quarters of revenue declines and regain momentum against larger rivals. Kroger is open normal hours, but pharmacies are closed. Harris Teeter stores are open normal hours. Meijer stores are open from 6 a.m. to midnight, according to the company's website. Stop and Shop locations are open from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., but pharmacies are closed. Trader Joe’s plans to be open regular business hours. Walmart is open normal hours. Whole Foods locations are open until 6 p.m. Winn-Dixie stores will be open normal business hours. Add TheStreet as a Preferred Source by clicking here. Madison Troyer April 5, 2026 2 min read If you feel like Easter gets a little more expensive every year, you aren’t alone. New data from the National Retail Federation shows that consumer spending on Easter is expected to hit a record high of $24.9 billion this year. Food is one of the largest contributors to that ballooning budget, accounting for $7.5 billion of total spend. “There's a bit of pain now associated with Easter because of higher prices,” Old Dominion University chair of the Department of Economics Bob McNab, told 13NewsNow. “If you're looking to buy the same things this year as last year, it's going to cost more.” But cooking a big Easter brunch or lunch doesn’t have to cost an arm and a leg. Dollar General recently expanded its grocery lineup, and its prices are just as competitive as Aldi or Walmart. Even better, Dollar General is open on Easter Sunday, making it easy to pick up all of those last-minute ingredients. Dollar General will be fully open on Easter 2026. The chain has more than 20,000 stores in 48 states. Operating hours aren’t universal, so for exact opening and closing times you can check your local store’s hours here. Dollar General stores will be open on Easter Sunday 2026.Shutterstock · Shutterstock Over the last few years, Dollar General has made a major effort to grow its grocery program. In 2023, the company said that it “now offers a meaningful selection of fresh fruits and vegetables in more locations than any other mass retailer or grocer in the United States.” Dollar General has made a particularly concerted effort to open locations in rural and underserved areas of the U.S., helping eliminate the number of food deserts in the country. In addition to pantry staples, 7,000 stores offer fresh produce, meat, and dairy products, meaning it’s now possible to make a full grocery run at the discount chain. In March, Dollar General announced it would be bringing on a new CEO, JJ Fleeman, in 2027. Fleeman was formerly a top executive at Ahold Delhaize, the parent company of several large supermarket chains. Given Fleeman’s experience, the move seems to signal Dollar General’s intent to expand even more into grocery segments over the coming years. Dana Sullivan Kilroy April 5, 2026 2 min read Weekends are for home projects, and Easter weekend is no different than any other for plenty of Americans. Whether this Sunday includes yard work, closet organizing or other spring cleaning, Home Depot likely has many of the supplies you need to get the jobs done. So you’ll be happy to know that The Home Depot will be open for business on Sunday, April 5. According to the Home Depot website, stores will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Home Depot has seen a decline in foot traffic in recent years.Suhail/Getty Images · Suhail/Getty Images Home Depot is one of those stores that rarely closes. In fact, Home Depot only closes two days each year: Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Home Depot, Inc. accounts for 52.4% of the home improvement market ($149.5 billion a year), according to data from IBISWorld. Still, visits to Home Depot have been down, so the company needs to keep its doors open as many days as possible. Home Depot's foot traffic declined about 3.8% year over year in Q1 2026, according to Placer.ai data shared on Yahoo Finance. Home Depot is open on Easter, which is good news if you're planning to tackle home projects. And even though the Home Depot website says stores are open on Easter, use the Home Depot locator to make sure your store is. Plenty of other major retailers are also open. Kroger is open normal hours, but pharmacies are closed. Harris Teeter stores are open normal hours. Meijer stores are open from 6 a.m. to midnight. Stop and Shop locations are open from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., but pharmacies are closed. Trader Joe’s plans to be open regular business hours. Walmart is open normal hours. Whole Foods locations are open until 6 p.m. Winn-Dixie stores will be open normal business hours. Madison Troyer April 5, 2026 2 min read If picking up a new outfit is a part of your Easter traditions, there’s no better place to shop than Kohl’s. The department store has the whole family covered, with a large selection of brands that run the gamut from casual to dressy, ensuring you’ll find the perfect look for whatever your holiday entails. Kohl’s is also one of the most budget-friendly retailers for your Easter outfits, thanks to its newly launched By Kohl’s campaign. The campaign brings together all of the department stores’ proprietary brands — including LC by Lauren Conrad, Simply Vera Vera Wang, FLX, Sea + Sky, and Jumping Beans — under a single banner, making it easier than ever to find high-quality, affordable options. But if you’re still on the hunt for a last-minute look, you’d better hurry. All Kohl’s locations will be closed on Easter Sunday. Kohl’s treats Easter Sunday as a full shutdown, closing all 1,100+ of its locations for the entire day. The holiday joins Thanksgiving and Christmas as one of three days each year the retailer takes a break and all employees have the day off. For the days surrounding the Easter holiday, you can check the opening hours of your local Kohl’s here. Kohl’s has locations in 49 states (there are currently no stores in Hawaii), that serve more than 60 million customers. Nearly 80% of Americans live within 15 miles of a Kohl’s store, according to the company. All Kohl's locations will be closed on Easter Sunday 2026.Getty Images · Getty Images If you didn’t make it to Kohl’s in time to buy your Easter outfit this year, it’s still well worth a trip to the retailer after the holiday is over. Kohl’s has a huge lineup of new arrivals this spring, including the introduction of two new lines, FLX Golf for Men and Sea + Sky for tween girls. The men’s big and tall assortment has also seen a full overhaul, with a refreshed lineup of items for the gym, the office, and everywhere in between. Beauty lovers will be excited to note that the Sephora at Kohl’s selection has expanded, with new drops from MAC Cosmetics and YSL Beauty. And if you’re looking to freshen up your home for the season, the Caro Home collection has a wide selection of bedding and bath essentials perfect for the sunnier months. Add TheStreet as a Preferred Source by clicking here. Madison Troyer April 5, 2026 2 min read Easter spending is on the rise. Recent predictions by the National Retail Federation put 2026 spending at $24.6 billion. While that number still pales in comparison to Christmas spending, which surpassed $1 trillion for the first time in 2025, it will still put quite a strain on many families this spring. “While economic uncertainty remains on the minds of many, consumers are still focused on holiday celebrations like Easter,” NRF Chief Economist and Executive Director of Research Mark Mathews said in a statement. “Holidays provide an important opportunity for families to reconnect and create lasting memories, even as economic conditions fluctuate.” Some of the biggest spending drivers for the holiday include gifts at $3.9 billion, candy at $3.5 billion, and flowers at $2.2 billion. But indulging in traditions like Easter baskets and egg hunts doesn’t have to break the bank. Discount stores, like Dollar Tree, are the top shopping destination for celebrants, with 55% planning to do the majority of their shopping at these retailers. If you’re among that group, and have put your Easter bunny duties off until the last minute, there’s no need to stress. Dollar Tree is open on Easter Sunday. All 9,000 of Dollar Tree’s North American locations will be open on Easter 2026. Stores set their own operating hours, meaning there is no universal open and closing time. Some stores may also be shortening their hours on the holiday, to give employees time to celebrate with friends and family. You can check the operating hours of your preferred Dollar Tree location here. Dollar Tree locations will be open on Easter 2026.Shutterstock · Shutterstock While Dollar Tree is still largely cheaper than competitors like Target and Walmart, the company has been slowly raising its prices. Last month, TheStreet’s Maurie Backman covered the retailer’s jump into $3, $5, and $7 price categories and the frustration that occasionally caused among its shoppers. “The appeal of Dollar Tree was the fact that you could grab any item and know what you were going to pay,” Backman said. “That’s no longer the case… Now, Dollar Tree customers have to check labels or scan items to figure out what prices they’re looking at. And a lot of people aren’t happy about that.” So if you are headed into Dollar Tree to grab those last minute Easter basket items or egg fillers, make sure you’re checking price tags lest you get to the register and are greeted with an unhappy holiday surprise.
